Runtime configuration, environment, SDK bootstrap, and feature flag rules.

integration.authority: Root SDKWork specs remain authoritative. Local cache specs may extend but must not contradict them.
integration.dependencyPolicy: Consumers integrate through @sdkwork/cache-core public exports and bind concrete stores in runtime bootstrap only.
integration.runtimeBindingPolicy: Desktop packaged runtimes must use local_cache instances. Service, Docker, and Kubernetes runtimes must use redis_cache instances.
integration.managementPolicy: Admin cache pages and operations should call application APIs backed by SdkworkCacheManager semantics instead of adapter internals. Cache instance keyPrefix values must be normalized, unique, and non-overlapping. Snapshot, refresh, and delete operations must be scoped by each cache instance keyPrefix so shared Redis databases or drivers never cross-count or invalidate unrelated keys.
integration.securityPolicy: Secret material must be referenced through connection profiles and protected runtime config, never browser-visible config.
